The combination of an 'exhaustion' candle pattern and the shift in C-suite leadership suggests the open will serve as the daily high as institutional sellers offload positions into the initial auction. Relying on this gap to hold would be a mistake, as the structural breakdown following the earnings miss indicates the market is already rotating out of the name.
